translations.text: To the Lord God almighty I confess my sins, and to his saints and to the servant of God, the sins I committed before: that is, in thoughts, in words, in deeds:
in perjuries, in curses, in slanders, in idle words; in hatred, in anger, in envy, in lust, in gluttony, in sleep and in unclean thoughts,

in the grasping [?] of my mind after forbidden things, in the lusts of the eyes, in the lusts of the will, in the lusts of the ears; in harshness toward the poor. I visited those shut up in prison very seldom.
I neglected to wash the feet of guests, and I visited the sick more slowly than I should have, and I did not invite the quarrelsome back to concord with all my heart and my whole mind.
When I should have fasted, I ate; and when holy lessons were read in the church, I was taken up with useless and idle talk.
While singing or praying I very often thought vain and useless things, and at meals I did not speak of things that were holy and good, but more often I spoke lewd things or slanders.
I also confess to God and to the servant of God my unbelief, idolatry, theft, manslaughter, and fornication beyond measure in the body and in the mind.
I committed arrogance and coveted the property of others. I bore false witness; I committed perjury.
I defiled myself with cattle and with four-footed beasts; I committed unchastity in the sodomitic manner; and I touched myself in my members in the lust of evil illusions.
I defiled myself through evil lust, and in that I saw with my eyes what was not permitted to me. I neglected to listen to God's commandment.
With the mouth with which I should have spoken good things I spoke vain and useless things, and with my hands I did what I should not have done.
I neglected what I was bound to do. With my feet I went where it was not permitted. I sat where I should have walked.
Whatever I, willingly or unwillingly, knowingly or unknowingly, thought against God's will, or spoke or did against my vow: in overeating, in drunkenness,
in vomiting, in robbery by force, in anger, in hatred, in lying, in immoderation, in too much talking, in lying, in whispering,
in disobedience, in mockery, in eating the blood of animals torn by beasts, in rejoicing at my neighbor's misfortune, and other sins without number:
all these I have confessed in pure confession to the Lord God almighty and to his saints and to the man of God. May he cleanse the sins I committed through the holy repentance of the fountain [?].
And since the renunciation and the vow of faith, many and countless are my sins, in thoughts, in deeds, and in words.
